group.title: Exhibition labels
group.passage:
M1: Maya, the photographs for our harbor exhibition have arrived, but the labels still show the dates we copied from the old catalog.
F1: Didn't the photographer's daughter send us corrections yesterday? I've been arranging the opening reception and haven't checked my messages.
M1: She did. Two pictures were taken in nineteen sixty-eight, not nineteen seventy-eight. I've marked those changes in the shared file.
F1: Good catch. The printer collects the file at three, so there's still time. Could you check the spelling of the boat names as well?
M1: Of course. Shall I contact her about the unsigned picture?
F1: No, I'll handle that. Please concentrate on the labels so we don't miss the printing deadline.
group.passageZh:
男：Maya，港口展的照片到了，但標籤還是從舊目錄抄來的日期。
女：攝影師的女兒不是昨天寄了更正嗎？我一直忙著安排開幕招待會，還沒看訊息。
男：寄了。有兩張是1968年拍攝，不是1978年。我已在共用檔標出修改。
女：幸好你發現了。印刷商三點來取檔，還有時間。也請檢查船名拼字好嗎？
男：當然。我要向她詢問那張未署名的照片嗎？
女：不用，我來處理。請專心處理標籤，以免錯過印刷期限。
